Use when the user has reference image(s) and wants to animate them into a video; mentions \"图生视频\", \"image2video\", \"图片转视频\", \"让这张图动起来\", \"首尾帧\", \"故事板\", \"多帧故事\", \"frames2video\"; or provides images and asks to generate a video from them. This skill covers 4 sub-mode templates with 18 annotated examples, a mode decision tree, and I2V-specific incremental description vocabulary. Always use this skill when the user wants to animate reference images into video using 即梦.
